all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.sum_moebius_divisors
all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.complete_source_header:
theorem sum_moebius_divisors (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ d ∈ n.divisors, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ)) =
      if n = 1 then 1 else 0

all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.coprime_indicator_eq_moebius
all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.complete_source_header:
theorem coprime_indicator_eq_moebius {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (m : ℕ) :
    (if m.Coprime q then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      ∑ d ∈ q.divisors, if d ∣ m then (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ) else 0

all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.coprime_weight_eq_moebius
all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.complete_source_header:
theorem coprime_weight_eq_moebius
    (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    (∑ m ∈ S, if m.Coprime q then w m else 0) =
      ∑ d ∈ q.divisors, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ) *
        ∑ m ∈ S, if d ∣ m then w m else 0

all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.coprimePrefix
all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.complete_source_definition:
def coprimePrefix (H q : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ m ∈ Ioc 0 H, if m.Coprime q then 1 else 0

all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.coprimePrefix_eq_divisor_sum
all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.complete_source_header:
theorem coprimePrefix_eq_divisor_sum (H : ℕ) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    coprimePrefix H q =
      ∑ d ∈ q.divisors, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ) * (H / d : ℕ)

all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.coprimePrefix_period
all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.complete_source_header:
theorem coprimePrefix_period (q : ℕ) :
    coprimePrefix q q = (q.totient : ℝ)

all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.moebius_density
all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.complete_source_header:
theorem moebius_density {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    (∑ d ∈ q.divisors, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) =
      (q.totient : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)

all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.scaledDyadicCutoff_finset_coprime_uniform_error
all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.complete_source_header:
theorem scaledDyadicCutoff_finset_coprime_uniform_error :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ M : ℝ, 0 < M → ∀ S : Finset ℕ,
      (∀ m : ℕ, scaledDyadicCutoff M m ≠ 0 → m ∈ S) →
      ∀ q : ℕ, q ≠ 0 →
      |(∑ m ∈ S, if m.Coprime q then scaledDyadicCutoff M m else 0) -
          (M * cutoffMass) * (q.totient : ℝ) / q| ≤ C * q.divisors.card

theorem exists_progression_for_divisor_congruence {q d n : ℕ}
    (hd : d.Coprime q) (hn : n.Coprime q) (a : ℤ) :
    ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ m : ℕ,
      (d ∣ m ∧ Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) a) ↔ Int.ModEq (q * d : ℕ) (m : ℤ) b

all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.scaledDyadicCutoff_finset_divisor_progression_uniform_error
all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.complete_source_header:
theorem scaledDyadicCutoff_finset_divisor_progression_uniform_error :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ M : ℝ, 0 < M → ∀ S : Finset ℕ,
      (∀ m : ℕ, scaledDyadicCutoff M m ≠ 0 → m ∈ S) →
      ∀ q d n : ℕ, 0 < q → 0 < d → d.Coprime q → n.Coprime q → ∀ a : ℤ,
      |(∑ m ∈ S,
          if d ∣ m ∧ Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) a then scaledDyadicCutoff M m else 0) -
        (M * cutoffMass / q) / d| ≤ C

all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.coprime_product_progression_weight_eq_moebius
all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.complete_source_header:
theorem coprime_product_progression_weight_eq_moebius
    (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) {q r n : ℕ} (hr : r ≠ 0)
    {a : ℤ} (ha : Int.gcd a q = 1) :
    (∑ m ∈ S, if m.Coprime r ∧ Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) a then w m else 0) =
      ∑ d ∈ r.divisors.filter (fun d ↦ d.Coprime q), (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ) *
        ∑ m ∈ S, if d ∣ m ∧ Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) a then w m else 0

all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.scaledDyadicCutoff_finset_coprime_progression_uniform_error
all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.complete_source_header:
theorem scaledDyadicCutoff_finset_coprime_progression_uniform_error :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ M : ℝ, 0 < M → ∀ S : Finset ℕ,
      (∀ m : ℕ, scaledDyadicCutoff M m ≠ 0 → m ∈ S) →
      ∀ q r n : ℕ, 0 < q → r ≠ 0 → n.Coprime q → ∀ a : ℤ, Int.gcd a q = 1 →
      |(∑ m ∈ S, if m.Coprime r ∧ Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) a
          then scaledDyadicCutoff M m else 0) -
        (M * cutoffMass / q) *
          ∑ d ∈ r.divisors.filter (fun d ↦ d.Coprime q),
            (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ) / d| ≤ C * r.divisors.card

all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.totient_real_prod
all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.complete_source_header:
private theorem totient_real_prod (n : ℕ) :
    (n.totient : ℝ) = n * ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹)

all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.restricted_moebius_density_prod
all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.complete_source_header:
theorem restricted_moebius_density_prod (q : ℕ) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    (∑ d ∈ r.divisors.filter (fun d ↦ d.Coprime q),
      (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ) / d) =
        ∏ p ∈ r.primeFactors.filter (fun p ↦ p.Coprime q), (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹)

all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.restricted_moebius_density
all_complete_headers_and_definition_bodi.complete_source_header:
theorem restricted_moebius_density {q r : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    (∑ d ∈ r.divisors.filter (fun d ↦ d.Coprime q),
      (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ) / d) / q =
        ((q * r).totient : ℝ) / ((q.totient : ℝ) * (q * r : ℕ))

sourceDAG_delta.basis: Current parent union containing CommonPoisson and staged SmoothProgressionError. The two explicit Mathlib imports are already positively reachable through CommonPoisson. Only the two supplied positive paths were read; no full closure rescan.

quantifier_and_domain_audit: Both arithmetic error endpoints quantify one positive C before every M>0, support-containing finite S, positive modulus, multiplier, and signed residue. No q<=M, r<=M, dyadic shortening, coefficient norm, error envelope, or residual-payment premise.
Coprime uniform error applies to every natural q!=0 and pays exactly C*card(divisors q), on the original finite carrier S.
Mixed divisor progression uniform error applies to every q,d>0 with d.Coprime q and n.Coprime q, and every signed integer a; it does not require a reduced residue at that construction stage.

Mixed coprime progression uniform error additionally uses Int.gcd a q=1, exactly the primitive arithmetic gate needed to exclude divisors sharing a prime with q. Its remainder is C*card(divisors r) for every r!=0.

restricted_moebius_density has only q,r!=0; prime powers and nonsquarefree moduli remain included. The filtered divisor sum is an exact finite Mobius identity, not a restriction on the consumer modulus carrier.
All analytic normalizations are the existing local cutoffMass and local scaledDyadicCutoff; no external integral normalization enters.

finite_mathematics_audit.assessment: The arithmetic-function zeta*Mobius identity gives the divisor sum. Divisors of q that also divide m are exactly divisors of gcd(m,q); q!=0 guarantees the divisor-set nonzero convention is valid, including m=0. The resulting indicator is exact.
Multiplies the exact indicator by arbitrary real w(m), then applies finite distributivity and Fubini. Signed weights are preserved until the final norm bounds.

finite_mathematics_audit.site: coprimePrefix definition, divisor sum, period, and moebius_density
finite_mathematics_audit.assessment: The sole definition is the exact count of coprime natural points in Ioc(0,H). Multiples are counted by floor(H/d); the full period is phi(q). Substituting H=q and exact divisibility gives the ordinary Mobius density phi(q)/q, with no asymptotic counting assumption.
Subtracts the exact Mobius zero mode and sums the proven local O(1) multiple-progression remainders. Every divisor is positive, |mu(d)|<=1, and triangle inequality yields C*card(divisors q).
Congruent integers have the same gcd with the modulus. A product congruent to a primitive signed residue is therefore coprime to q; the natural coprime-product equivalence supplies both factors.

An inverse y of d*n modulo q constructs b=d*y*a, so b is 0 modulo d and b*n is a modulo q. An inverse of n cancels the product congruence. Coprime CRT combines m=b mod q and m=b mod d into m=b mod q*d. This is an actual residue construction.

The constructed equivalence rewrites the actual finite sum to one progression modulo q*d; the local uniform error applies since q*d>0. (M*cutoffMass/q)/d is algebraically identical to (M/(q*d))*cutoffMass.

Applies exact Mobius inversion with the product congruence retained. If d shares a factor with q, any d|m in the congruence contradicts the proved m.Coprime q; those summands are exactly zero. No physical modulus or paired carrier is dropped.
Subtracts the restricted Mobius main term and uses the actual divisor-progression O(1) error. |mu|<=1 and card(filter)<=card(divisors r) give the stated uniform bound with no budget premise.

The totient product is the standard rational formula mapped to reals. The product k of primes dividing r and coprime to q is squarefree, coprime to q, and divides r. Every squarefree contributing divisor divides k; all omitted nonsquarefree divisors have Mobius zero. Thus the filtered sum equals the full Mobius density of k and the displayed finite prime product.

The relevant primes are primeFactors(r) minus primeFactors(q). The prime product of q times that complement is the prime product of q*r. Nonzero q,r and phi(q)>0 justify exact field identities, yielding phi(q*r)/(phi(q)*(q*r)).
